0022600008.text: The Knicks (0-1, 12th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (0-1, 14th in the East) in New York's second game of the season, with both teams still searching for their first win. Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 112-106 regular-season win in New York on April 9, 2026.
